name: Extruder Tube Cooler for K8200 printer

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a hollow, tapered blower nozzle designed for a radial fan, transitioning from a larger rectangular intake at the bottom to a smaller, offset rectangular outlet at the top. Extending from one side of the base is a stepped mounting arm with a single vertical screw hole, allowing it to clamp or bolt onto a printer's extruder assembly. The main nozzle body has thin, uniform walls and a smooth, angled transition to guide airflow efficiently.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric radial blower nozzle for a 3D printer extruder. The model should feature a hollow, lofted transition duct from a wide rectangular fan intake to a narrower outlet, and include an integrated mounting tab extending from the base with a screw hole and stepped adjustment ridges.
captions.factory: The script constructs the hollow nozzle using a difference of two hull operations, each lofting between a bottom cube and an offset top cube to define the outer shell and inner airway. A stepped mounting arm is created using a series of translated cubes of varying widths and heights, then a cylinder is subtracted from it to form a mounting screw hole. A small reinforcing fillet is added at the junction of the nozzle and the arm using an intersection of a rotated cylinder and a cube.
